title: Mystic Crystal Orb
description: A glowing crystal ball sits on an ornate dark metal stand decorated with Celtic knotwork. Bright blue, purple and pink energy streams with branching lightning and spiral patterns emanate from its center while a green tattooed finger points toward it from the right.
